facts.premium: Upper-Isan province; ~92% informal — among the highest informal shares in Thailand.
facts.skill_gap: Very thin formal employment; smallholder farming and indigo/cattle dominate.
anchors: Rice and cassava farming; cattle raising
Sakon Nakhon University and regional services
Lake Nong Han fisheries and rural retail
workers: Rice and cassava farmers and cattle raisers
impacts: Income hinges on the monsoon harvest across most districts.
Cassava income pressured by sharp YoY price falls.
Cattle and indigo-textile trade add non-grain income streams.
~92% informal means income is largely undocumented and seasonal — repayment risk.
Heavy dependence on transfers from migrant workers.
